description: Given a procedure and the list of items already documented in the chart, audits the note against the Medicare required-documentation checklist and returns what is satisfied, what is still missing (with rationale and suggested wording), a spotlight on commonly-missed gaps, and an overall completeness score. PREMIUM tier.

documented.description: Items already documented — checklist item ids or free-text phrases (e.g. "MRI findings", "conservative care 8 weeks").

procedure.description: Procedure name, id, or CPT code.

name: check_documentation_completeness
title: Check Documentation Completeness
